description: This header file defines the GStreamerMSEMediaPlayerClient class and related message classes for a media player client that uses GStreamer for media streaming, including buffer pulling, playback state management, and source attachment/detachment.

classes.name: BufferPuller
classes.description: Handles pulling buffers from the media sink and manages a message queue for buffer requests.

classes.name: HaveDataMessage
classes.description: Represents a message indicating media source has data available.

classes.name: PullBufferMessage
classes.description: Represents a message to pull buffer data from the sink.

classes.name: NeedDataMessage
classes.description: Represents a request for more media data.

classes.name: PlaybackStateMessage
classes.description: Represents a change in playback state.

classes.name: QosMessage
classes.description: Represents a Quality of Service (QoS) update.

classes.name: AttachedSource
classes.description: Associates a media source with its sink and manages seeking state.

classes.name: GStreamerMSEMediaPlayerClient
classes.description: Main class implementing a media player client using GStreamer, managing media sources, playback, and buffer handling.

methods.name: notifyDuration
methods.description: Notify the duration of the media.

methods.name: notifyNativeSize
methods.description: Notify the native video size and aspect ratio.

methods.name: notifyVideoData
methods.description: Notify whether video data is available.

methods.name: notifyAudioData
methods.description: Notify whether audio data is available.

methods.name: notifyNeedMediaData
methods.description: Notify that media data is needed for a specific source.

methods.name: notifyCancelNeedMediaData
methods.description: Cancel media data request for a source.

methods.name: notifyQos
methods.description: Notify QoS information for a source.

methods.name: notifyBufferUnderflow
methods.description: Notify buffer underflow event for a source.

methods.name: addSegment
methods.description: Add a media segment to the pipeline.

methods.name: attachSource
methods.description: Attach a media source to the player.

methods.name: setVideoRectangle
methods.description: Set the video rectangle for rendering.

methods.name: requestPullBuffer
methods.description: Request to pull buffer data for a stream.

methods.name: notifySourceStartedSeeking
methods.description: Notify that a source has started seeking.

methods.name: startPullingDataIfSeekFinished
methods.description: Start pulling data after seeking is finished.

methods.name: renderFrame
methods.description: Render a frame from the sink.
